The edit script vocabulary every algorithm in this module produces.

Kept apart from myers.nim so the anchoring passes can build and splice scripts without importing the search itself, and so the shape of a diff is stated exactly once.

types

Types

LineOp = object
  kind*: LineOpKind
  aIdx*: int
  bIdx*: int

One step of an edit script, as line indices into each side.

A consumed line always carries its index. The side a step does not consume is -1, which is exactly how a consumer tells a one-sided step from a matched pair without consulting kind.

LineOpKind = enum
  opEqual, opDelete, opInsert ## Mirrors `DiffLineKind`. Kept distinct until `ops.nim` fuses a script
                              ## into `DiffLine`s, so no stage has to guess at a conversion.
